name: One Registration replica fails
user_impact: Second replica remains online; reduced headroom, possibly brief 5xx before removal
method: deterministic model; a failed endpoint removed after two readiness checks

name: Both Registration replicas fail
user_impact: Registration unavailable until first replacement is ready; other services unaffected
method: deterministic model; deployment replaces pods, 25s startup assumption

name: Database becomes unavailable
user_impact: DB-dependent registration requests fail; readiness removes both endpoints
method: deterministic model; DB manually restored at t=180, next readiness check t=185
